title: Open Label Extension for 43USSA1812
brief_summary: To evaluate long-term safety and effectiveness data of Sculptra Aesthetic beyond the Month 12 duration of the pivotal study 43USSA1812 (NCT04124692) to help characterize the long-term safety and effectiveness profile of the more dilute suspension.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Subject completed Month 12 of study 43USSA1812
2. Subjects willing to comply with the requirements of the extension of the study and providing a signed written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. For subjects eligible for treatment in the extension study, the exclusion criteria for study 43USSA1812 applies.
